agent_summary:
Error-handling lane for juice.lab.test (OWASP Juice Shop, HTTP only — port 443 does not answer). Both items tested read-only and marked done.

WSTG-ERRH-02 (stack traces) — DONE. The default Express error page is served on many error conditions, exposing the framework/version string "OWASP Juice Shop (Express ^4.22.1)" and, in many cases, full stack traces with absolute server source paths (/juice-shop/build/routes/*.js, /juice-shop/node_modules/express/...). Confirmed triggers: 403 /ftp/<blocked-ext> (fileServer.js), 406 /redirect (redirect.js), 400 /%c0%af URIError (compression/express internals, served before security-header middleware), and 500s on /rest/admin/9999, /rest/order-history (also leaks internal container IP ::ffff:172.25.0.2), /rest/products/{invalid|nonexistent id}, /rest/track-order, /rest/user/data-export, /rest/user/security-question, /dataerasure, /profile, and many auto-generated model endpoints (/api/Baskets, /api/Wallets, /api/Memorys, /api/Captchas, /api/Reviews, /api/Orders, /api/Images).

WSTG-ERRH-01 (improper error handling) — DONE. Error handling is not centralized/sanitized: (a) the same unauthenticated 401 is returned in >=5 different forms depending on route — HTML version page (972B), structured JSON {error:{name,code,inner}} under Accept:json, JSON leaking raw JS TypeError "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'data')" (/rest/wallet/balance, /api/Cards, /api/Addresss), text/plain "Unauthorized" (/rest/saveLoginIp), and nginx-level generic pages with no app headers (/api/Challenges, path traversal); (b) /rest/country-mapping returns a bodyless 500; (c) many REST routes return 500 instead of a clean 404/400/401; (d) soft-404: /.env, /.git/HEAD, /sitemap.xml, /crossdomain.xml and arbitrary unknown top-level paths return HTTP 200 serving the SPA index while /api/* returns a JSON 404; (e) SQL error text (SQLITE_ERROR ...) is reflected on 500s.

Leads recorded: verbose stack traces + internal IP disclosure (low); internal JS exception text + bodyless 500 (low); inconsistent error formats (low); and a side-observation for info/conf lanes — directory listings at /encryptionkeys, /support/logs, /ftp/quarantine and direct retrieval of /ftp/incident-support.kdbx (KeePass DB, 200/3246B) (medium).

Nothing left open. Reachable surface exercised includes /, /ftp (+ files), /redirect, /metrics, /robots.txt, /.well-known/security.txt, /video, /promotion, and the /rest/* and /api/* families. Writes were not needed (lane is read-only). Note: display budget was exhausted partway, so later findings are evidenced by status/size/headers with full bodies retained as evidence.

leads.title: [agent] Directory listings and sensitive file retrieval: /encryptionkeys, /support/logs, /ftp/quarantine, /ftp/incident-support.kdbx

detail.text: GET /encryptionkeys (HTTP 200, text/html serve-index listing, 7954B) and GET /support/logs (HTTP 200, serve-index listing, 8923B) expose directory listings. GET /ftp/quarantine returns a 200 listing (9616B). GET /ftp/incident-support.kdbx returned HTTP 200 application/octet-stream with 3246 bytes (the KeePass database retrieved directly, not only via the previously reported null-byte bypass). For info/conf lanes to confirm and assess the retrieved contents.

leads.title: [agent] Inconsistent error formats and internal exception leakage across routes

detail.text: The application returns at least five different error representations for comparable failures: (1) Express HTML error page disclosing "OWASP Juice Shop (Express ^4.22.1)" and stack traces, (2) structured JSON error objects under Accept: application/json, (3) JSON leaking raw JS TypeError text "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'data')" (GET /rest/wallet/balance, /api/Cards), (4) text/plain "Unauthorized" (GET /rest/saveLoginIp), (5) nginx-level generic 400/404 pages with no application headers (GET /ftp/..%2f..%2fetc/passwd, /api/Challenges). The inconsistency plus leaked internal exception strings indicate error handling is not centralized/sanitized.

leads.title: [agent] Internal JS exception text and bodyless 500 leaked by API error handling

detail.text: GET /rest/wallet/balance and GET /api/Addresss/notanumber (unauthenticated) return 401 with body {"status":"error","message":"Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'data')"}, exposing an internal JavaScript TypeError instead of a clean auth error. GET /rest/country-mapping returns HTTP 500 with an empty body and no Content-Type (unhandled exception). These indicate inconsistent/improper error handling across the REST API.

leads.title: [agent] Verbose Express stack traces and internal IP disclosed on error pages

detail.text: Several routes render the default Express error page containing full stack traces with absolute server paths (/juice-shop/build/routes/*.js, node_modules/express/...) and the framework version string "OWASP Juice Shop (Express ^4.22.1)". Triggers: GET /ftp/package.json.bak (403), GET /redirect?to=http://evil.example.com (406), GET /%c0%af (400 URIError), GET /rest/admin/9999 (500), GET /rest/order-history (500, additionally leaks internal container IP ::ffff:172.25.0.2). Error page is served before security-header middleware on the 400 URIError case (headers like X-Frame-Options absent).
